content:
**E.M.T.** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Automatically revive downed teammates once every 3 minutes and grant them increased healing for 1 minute.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Automatically revive downed teammates once every 3 minutes and grant them increased healing for 1 minute. | 00029285 | 

Prior to the *C.A.M.P. Revamp* update, this perk had three ranks and provided health regeneration for 15/30/60 seconds to revived players. 

"E.M.T." is an abbreviation of "emergency medical technician," a health professional that can perform urgent life-saving procedures.
